# Proverbs 3 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 3:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | My-son, my-teaching do-not-forget, and-my-commandments let-your-heart keep, |
| LOGOS | My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments, |
| PNEUMA | My child, don't forget what I've taught you — hold onto my instructions with everything you've got, |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| PNEUMA | Never let loyalty and honesty slip away from you. Wear them like a necklace; engrave them deep in your heart. |
